instruction: The precondition assembly file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the starting assembly shown in the before image. Complete the assembly so it matches the target shape shown in the after image while using the correct physical joint behavior. Toggle Grounded for the larger cube and apply a Distance Joint so the two closest faces shown in the image are 5 mm apart. Save the completed assembly to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
